exclusions_of_note.name: Employers' Liability — Liability Assumed Under Contract
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard EL exclusion — does not cover liability assumed under contract (except warranty of workmanlike work). Tort indemnity to a third party for injury to insured's employee may still be covered under §B.1.

exclusions_of_note.name: Employers' Liability — Federal Acts (USL&H, Jones Act, FELA, DBA, Nonappropriated Fund, OCSLA)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes work subject to USL&H, Nonappropriated Fund, OCSLA, Defense Base Act, FELA, and crew of any vessel. No USL&H or Jones Act coverage absent endorsement.

exclusions_of_note.name: Employers' Liability — Discrimination/Personnel Practices Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes damages from coercion, criticism, demotion, evaluation, reassignment, discipline, defamation, harassment, humiliation, discrimination, termination, or any personnel practices/policies/acts/omissions. EPLI required to fill this gap.

exclusions_of_note.name: Employers' Liability — Bodily Injury Outside US/Canada
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes BI occurring outside US/territories/possessions/Canada, except for US/Canadian citizens temporarily abroad.

exclusions_of_note.name: Employers' Liability — Punitive Damages / Illegally-Employed Workers
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes punitive/exemplary damages and BI to employees employed in violation of law with insured's knowledge.

exclusions_of_note.name: Florida EL — Intentional Conduct Exclusion (Modified)
exclusions_of_note.impact: FL replacement of EL Exclusion 5. Excludes intentional injury and conduct equivalent to intentional tort that would deprive insured of civil-liability immunity under FL WC law. Broader than standard exclusion 5.

exclusions_of_note.name: Indiana — No Voluntary Compensation / No Broad Form Other States Modifications
exclusions_of_note.impact: For Indiana, the Broad Form's Voluntary Compensation & EL Coverage section is deleted entirely. Indiana operations rely on standard NCCI WC 00 00 00 with no Voluntary Comp safety net. Material if any IN employee performs work outside the states scheduled under Item 3.A.

exclusions_of_note.name: Illinois — Liability Assumed Under Contract / Waiver of Contribution Right Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: IL only. Excludes liability assumed under contract AND any agreement to waive insured's right to limit liability for contribution under IL WC Act and Occupational Disease Act. Workmanlike-manner warranty preserved. PRACTICAL: in IL, contract clauses requiring Run-Test to waive its statutory contribution limitations would be uninsured.

exclusions_of_note.name: Oregon — Intentional Acts / Tortious Conduct / ORS 656.019 / ORS 654.305-336 Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: OR only. Excludes intentional bodily injury/aggravation, intentional-tort-equivalent conduct, tortious conduct or activity per ORS 656.018(3) stripping employer immunity, and any cause of action under ORS 656.019 or ORS 654.305-336.

exclusions_of_note.name: Trade or Economic Sanctions Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: No coverage to extent trade/economic sanctions or other laws prohibit insurer from providing coverage. OFAC-style exclusion.

exclusions_of_note.name: California — Punitive/Exemplary Damages Uninsurable
exclusions_of_note.impact: CA does not cover punitive/exemplary damages where insurance prohibited by law or contrary to public policy.

exclusions_of_note.name: California — Minors Illegally Employed Not Insured
exclusions_of_note.impact: No coverage for additional comp imposed under CA Labor Code §4557 for injury to employee under 16 illegally employed.

exclusions_of_note.name: California EL — Flying Crew Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: CA excludes BI to any member of the flying crew of any aircraft.

exclusions_of_note.name: California EL — Failure to Secure WC Obligations
exclusions_of_note.impact: CA excludes BI to employee where insured deprived of statutory/common law defenses or subject to penalty for failure to secure WC obligations.

exclusions_of_note.name: California EL — Labor Code §2810.3 Liability Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: CA excludes liability arising from Labor Code §2810.3 (labor contracting / staffing arrangement liability).

exclusions_of_note.name: Arkansas — Punitive/Exemplary Damages (EL)
exclusions_of_note.impact: AR modified EL exclusion — punitive/exemplary damages because of BI to employee in violation of law (per AR Bulletin 4-82) excluded.
